description: Links a laboratory test to a disease that its LOINC Component axis is about. Disease-association tests, such as serology tests, are about a disease rather than literally measuring it.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory tests with LOINC CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; deprecated codes are excluded. Disease associations use the Component axis only; disease-typed specimens on the System axis do not produce this relationship.
source_contributions.description: Disease associations include identifier-based mappings and curated mappings of otherwise unresolved LOINC parts produced by an LLM-assisted curation pass. Coverage is limited to diseases present in SPOKE. Ambiguous UMLS concept mappings to multiple diseases are excluded. Challenge agents are excluded from analyte associations.
